item.title: Sail the Med in style: New Excess catamarans available for charter
item.description: As the summer season approaches, Mediterranean sailing beckons with its crystal-clear waters, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage. What better way to experience the Med than on a brand-new Excess Catamaran, perfectly designed for a sailing vacation of a lifetime? We have sparkling new fresh-from-the-factory Excess Catamarans arriving, and we’re excited to offer them for charter in some of the most amazing destinations in the Mediterranean, including Montenegro, the French Riviera, and Croatia. Get to know Excess sailing catamarans These sleek and stylish Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are just a few of the latest exciting additions to our Dream Yacht fleet, and they’re packed with features that make them perfect for sailors and those looking to explore the best of the Mediterranean from aboard a new, thoughtfully-designed Excess charter yacht. If you haven’t sailed aboard an Excess Catamaran before, you’re in for a treat. Excess yachts place a special design emphasis on a satisfying sailing experience, with exceptional responsiveness at the helm and heightened sailing “sensations”. Excess achieves an excellent level of onboard comfort as well – but not at the expense of performance. Meet the Excess 14 & Excess 11 The recently released Excess 14 is gaining momentum with sailing enthusiasts for its substantial 46-ft length offering uniquely nimble handling, reduced drag and improved stability. The Dream Yacht charter version features 4-cabins and 4-baths with plenty of space for a larger group of Mediterranean adventurers. The smaller Excess 11 is 37-ft of sailing fun. It’s perfect for small groups and families to explore the Mediterranean, with 4 comfortable cabins and 2 baths. For those newer to sailing it’s designed for ease of sailing, with excellent visibility and self-tacking jib. More experienced sailors will appreciate the lively helm and thrilling sailing sensations. Both models feature the latest technology and innovations from Excess, including a sleek and modern design, a large cockpit with a sliding glass door, and a spacious salon with plenty of natural light. They are also equipped with a range of amenities, including air conditioning, generator, and watermaker, ensuring a comfortable and convenient sailing experience. Whether you’re an experienced sailor or just starting out, the Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are sure to impress. Their combination of performance, comfort, and style makes them the perfect choice for a Med charter vacation. The new Excess 13 In addition to the Excess 11 and 14, Excess has announced that their newest catamaran offering will be announced at the upcoming La Grand Motte boat show this spring. The exciting new Excess 13 is a sleek, dependable and lively sailboat – a perfect charter vacation platform. Watch for arrivals into the Dream Yacht Charter fleet soon! Charter a New Excess 14 – Trogir, Croatia Trogir, located on the Dalmatian coast of Croatia, is a historic town surrounded by a stunning archipelago, with countless islands, bays, and beaches to explore – the perfect starting point for your Croatia sailing charter . Trogir is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with a rich history dating back to the ancient Greeks and Romans. The town’s narrow streets and picturesque piazzas are filled with historic landmarks, including the stunning Trogir Cathedral and the Kamerlengo Fortress. The surrounding islands, such as the famed Hvar and Brač, offer a range of sailing opportunities, from secluded beaches to vibrant ports and harbors. Our new Excess 14 catamaran is available for charters from our base in Trogir, Croatia beginning June 14, 2025 offering the perfect opportunity to experience the best of Croatia’s sailing scene. Plan now and grab your chance at summer sailing aboard this brand new Dream Yacht “Super Premiere” sailing catamaran. item.title: This spring, sail beyond the ordinary in the Exotics
item.description: Dare to sail the exotic, far-flung corners of the world! As the weather starts to warm up, many of us begin to think about our next big adventure. For sailing enthusiasts, there’s no better way to explore the world’s most stunning destinations than from the deck of a Dream Yacht charter. With an unparalleled range of exotic sailing destinations, a Dream Yacht charter vacation offers the ultimate bucket list experience. Whether sailing the crystal-clear waters of Thailand, taking in the breathtaking landscapes of Tahiti and French Polynesia, or cruising the stunning archipelagos of Seychelles, the freedom and adventure offered by a yacht charter simply cannot be matched by land-based holidays. This spring, don’t let your dreams of sailing and exploring exotic destinations go unfulfilled. Seize the opportunity to make them a reality and experience the thrill of sailing through an exotic paradise, interacting with vibrant local cultures, and seeking out bold adventures along the way. Take the leap and book your sailing vacation now. Create lifelong memories, challenge yourself, and broaden your horizons – your dream getaway is just one decision away. Need a bit more inspiration? Here are some of our top exotic destinations for an epic spring sailing adventure: Thailand: Exotic landscapes – warm & welcoming culture Thailand is a sailor’s paradise, with its turquoise waters, lush islands, and vibrant culture. When sailing in Thailand with Dream Yacht Charter, you’ll have access to some of the most stunning islands in the Andaman Sea or Gulf of Thailand. Highlights include exploring Phang Nga Bay’s towering limestone cliffs rising dramatically out of emerald waters; snorkeling or diving among coral reefs teeming with marine life; relaxing on idyllic beaches like Railay Beach or Koh Phi Phi Don where powdery white sand meets a crystal-clear jade-colored sea, and visiting bustling markets where local artisans showcase colorful handicrafts alongside delectable thai street food. Awaken to the gentle sound of waves lapping against the hull of your yacht, grab a cup of coffee and step out on deck to be greeted by stunning lush landscapes and glistening seas beckoning you for a swim. Perhaps today you’ll kayak through mysterious caves and jungles under the watchful eye of curious monkeys, or snorkel coral reefs near Maya Beach on Phi Phi Le, where the movie “The Beach” was filmed. Spring is the perfect time to sail in Thailand, when you will encounter milder temperatures and comfortable wind conditions. This is a good time for water sports enthusiasts to visit, as conditions are calm and conducive to activities like snorkeling and diving. Learn more about sailing in Thailand , and start planning your dream adventure! French Polynesia & Bora Bora: The ultimate tropical island escape Tahiti and French Polynesia are synonymous with friendly Tahitian culture and dramatic tropical scenery – think overwater bungalows perched above coral reefs teeming with marine life, and swaying palm fronds carrying the sweet scent of frangipani flowers and vanilla farms. It’s an intoxicating amalgam of sights, sounds and scents found nowhere else on the planet! Begin your sailing adventure from our base on Raiatea, and sail to Bora Bora to witness firsthand the majesty and sheer scale of famed Mount Otemanu, a sight you won’t soon forget. Snorkel in pristine lagoons enclosed by protective barrier coral, and experience the local culture at small vanilla and pearl farms. Local tour guides are happy to share the mysterious history of ancient temples and archaeological sites, and lead hikes through dense tropical rainforests to hidden waterfalls. Above all, don’t miss drift snorkeling through the vibrant coral gardens at Le Taha’a – a charter guest favorite. Spring in French Polynesia brings calm seas, gentle trade winds, and warm temperatures perfect for sailing and exploring the islands. Come and enjoy an unmatched vacation with Dream Yacht in French Polynesia. …
